mapper.sql: v.id, v.workbook_id, v.version_number, v.dataset_version_id, v.status, v.document_json, v.compiled_plan_json, v.content_hash, v.created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rule_workbook_versions ( id, workbook_id, version_number, dataset_version_id, status, document_json, compiled_plan_json, content_hash, created_at ) VALUES ( #{id,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}, #{workbookId,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}, #{versionNumber}, #{datasetVersionId,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{documentJson}, #{compiledPlanJson}, #{contentHash}, #{createdAt,typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.InstantTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM rule_workbook_versions v JOIN rule_workbooks w ON w.id = v.workbook_id WHERE v.workbook_id = #{workbookId,typeHandler=com.olist.datasets.typehandler.UuidTypeHandler} AND w.owner_id = #{ownerId} ORDER BY v.version_number DESC LIMIT 1
